results.question: For each portfolio, show the total value of Technology sector holdings and what percentage it represents of the total portfolio value
results.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM sectors WHERE sector_name = 'Technology') THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) AS tech_value, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_value, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.sector_id = (SELECT sector_id FROM sectors WHERE sector_name = 'Technology') THEN h.quantity * s.current_price ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price), 2) AS tech_percentage FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id

results.question: Find portfolios that have holdings in more than 5 different sectors and show their diversification metrics
results.sql:
WITH PortfolioSectorCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        h.portfolio_id, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS sector_count
    FROM holdings h
    JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id
    WHERE s.asset_type = 'Stock'
    GROUP BY h.portfolio_id
    HAVING sector_count > 5
),
PortfolioTotalHoldings AS (
    SELECT 
        portfolio_id, 
        COUNT(holding_id) AS total_holdings
    FROM holdings
    GROUP BY portfolio_id
)
SELECT 
    p.portfolio_name, 
    psc.sector_count, 
    pth.total_holdings, 
    ROUND(CAST(psc.sector_count AS REAL) / pth.total_holdings, 3) AS diversification_ratio
FROM PortfolioSectorCounts psc
JOIN PortfolioTotalHoldings pth ON psc.portfolio_id = pth.portfolio_id
JOIN portfolios p ON psc.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id
ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC;
